Fifty Fifty: the fruit slicing game where halves count

DAY 5October 10, 2026ArcadeCasualSkillSwipeFree · no download
PLAY

Fifty Fifty is a free fruit slicing game you play by swiping. Fruit flies up onto a wooden cutting board and you slash through it with your finger or mouse. The twist: the game measures every cut. Each half flies off showing its share of the fruit, like 47% and 53%, so you always know exactly how close you came. Play it right here in your browser on a phone or a computer.

The closer you get to a true 50 | 50, the more points you score. Chain GOOD cuts or better to build a streak and multiply your points up to ×4, and every cut in a streak rings one note higher. Land a PERFECT 50 | 50 and time slows, gold confetti bursts and the music swells. Miss a fruit or hack off a lopsided sliver and you take a strike. Three strikes, or a single bomb, ends the run. Unlike a classic fruit cutting game, mashing doesn't work here: aim beats speed.

How to play Fifty Fifty

  1. Tap to start. Fruit is tossed up from the bottom of the screen.
  2. Swipe straight through each fruit. Aim for the exact middle.
  3. Each half shows its share of the fruit. 50 | 50 is a PERFECT, 48 to 49 is SO CLOSE, 45 to 47 is GREAT, 40 to 44 is GOOD and 25 to 39 is OK.
  4. GOOD cuts or better build your streak. Every 5 in a row adds a points multiplier, up to ×4. An OK cut resets the streak.
  5. A fruit that falls uncut, or a lopsided cut under 25%, is a strike. Three strikes ends the run, and so does slicing a bomb.
  6. Tap anywhere on the game-over card to slice again instantly.

Controls

OnControls
Phone or tabletSwipe your finger through the fruit
ComputerClick and drag the mouse through the fruit
RetryTap, click, or press Space or Enter after the run ends

Tips for a higher score

  • Wait for the fruit to slow near the top of its arc. It is easiest to cut dead centre when it is barely moving.
  • Make short, straight swipes. A long slash can clip a second fruit and leave a lopsided strike.
  • Long fruit like lemons and watermelons still split 50 | 50 through their centre, at any angle.
  • Bombs glow red and hiss. Swipe around them, never through them.
  • Golden apples are worth double points and 5 bonus coins (◆).
  • Every 15 cuts the board changes: FARMERS MARKET, CITRUS GROVE, TROPICAL BEACH, SUNSET DOJO, NIGHT MARKET and MOONLIGHT. Each adds new fruit and throws them faster.

Fifty Fifty FAQ

Is Fifty Fifty free?

Yes. It's free to play in your browser with no download, no install and no account.

Can I play Fifty Fifty on my phone?

Yes. It was made for phones held upright, and it also works on desktop with a mouse.

How does the game measure the cut?

It works out the exact area of fruit on each side of your swipe and rounds it to a whole percent. Both halves show their number, so 50 | 50 means you cut it within a hair of the true middle.

Is this like Fruit Ninja?

It's a fruit slicing game too, but the goal is precision, not speed. Points come from how evenly you cut, so careful swipes beat frantic ones.

Is my progress saved?

Your best score, coins and blades are saved in your browser on this device.
